svg.text: Against zzq_fakebroker: it counts what a publishing client sends; a subscribing client counts what it receives.
rumqttc speaks MQTT 3.1.1, the rest 5.0. emqtt publishes QoS 1 and 2 from 100 processes.
MQTT clients, one connection, TCP loopback
Intel Core i7-8700B @ 3.20 GHz (KVM), performance governor, turbo off
